query:
SELECT s.id AS "id!"
        FROM unnest($1::uuid[]) AS links(link_id)
        CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
            SELECT t.id
            FROM email_threads t
            WHERE t.link_id = links.link_id
              AND t.latest_outbound_message_ts IS NOT NULL
            ORDER BY t.latest_outbound_message_ts DESC
            LIMIT $2
        ) s
        LIMIT $2
